Access, hardware and performance
Capabilities
Same default as the RF-Swift CLI: uses host DISPLAY (or :0) and mounts /tmp/.X11-unix. Host X access control must allow the container user.
Remote desktop (noVNC / VNC)
The selected RF-Swift image must include its desktop scripts. Local-only binding is recommended.
Bind mounts and devices
Mounts the USB bus and adds c 189:* rwm.
For USB hotplug, prefer the RF-Swift profile or USB hotplug defaults: binding /dev/bus/usb survives individual USB-node changes. Binding all of /dev exposes every host device and is not recommended. Serial nodes such as ttyACM may still require an exact device mapping.
Ports and isolation

USB passthrough - Lima VM

Forward a host USB device (SDR, Proxmark, HackRF...) into the Lima VM over QMP hot-plug, so containers running on the Lima engine can use it. The VM must be running. This is the GUI equivalent of rfswift macusb attach.
